title: Backup & Migration Center
subtitle: Create 100% faithful backups for auditing or server migration.
exportDesc: Choose the desired format. For system migration (SQL/Supabase), always use JSON.
restoreDesc: Restores the system to the exact state of a previously saved .JSON file.
